shortDescription: Sends Toast windows notification to logged in users on Windows 10 or later hosts

options.name: expire
options.description: How long in seconds before the notification expires.

options.name: group
options.description: Which notification group to add the notification to.

options.name: msg
options.description: The message to appear inside the notification. May include \n to format the message to appear within the Action Center.

options.name: popup
options.description: If C(no), the notification will not pop up and will only appear in the Action Center.

options.name: tag
options.description: The tag to add to the notification.

options.name: title
options.description: The notification title, which appears in the pop up..
